body:
But the other is closed.

After reading the old issue, I think it'd be better to change the core API and make required attributeName if there are problems with normalizations.

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/bbb2798d416edffa5435792ee98ce16029e22682/packages/core/src/di/metadata.ts#L268-L278

> After reading the old issue, I think it'd be better to change the core API and make required attributeName if there are problems with normalizations.

Agreed, seems the type signature is incorrect.
I'd raise the question of why for attributes it has to be mandatory, but not for inputs. I believe these should be handled consistently.
@Airblader You have to read related issue https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/4607 . But basically there are problems normalizing tag attributes to variables and the other way round.
Yeah, this is weird. We should make the attribute name required in the type to make it clear how we expect folks to use it.

issue.body:
`Attribute` decorator has defined `attributeName` as optional but actually its
 mandatory and compiler throwa an error if `attributeName` is undefined. Made
`attributeName` mandatory in the `Attribute` decorator to reflect this functionality

Fixes #32658
